scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical. Supplemental symbolic and seeded numerical checks are not independent validation. The historical Philip paper has a verified print month in 1957 but no verified exact day; 2005-02-23 is the earliest calendar-day-resolved motivating research source used for date classification. No authorship or peer review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the exact positive two-term Philip approximation at four arbitrary known timestamps. It is structurally exact but not noise-stable uniformly, and does not establish Richards-equation validity, field estimation precision, or uniqueness in higher-order or multi-layer models.
title: Four arbitrarily timed infiltration readings recover an unknown Philip clock and gauge origin
